# Style properties

<!-- generated by `cargo xtask style-props` from `twine_style::PROP_META`, `PROP_ALIASES` and `SHORTHANDS`; do not edit -->

All 129 properties of `twine-style` (LVGL v9.6 `lv_style_prop_t`), in id order. Each has one name, the **key**: the `style!` key, the `StyleBuf` builder method and the `twine-view` modifier (`ViewExt`); the `PropId`/`StyleProp` variant is the same name in `PascalCase`. The former names (the previous Twine key and the LVGL constant) are `#[doc(alias)]`es only: `style!` rejects them. Flags are LVGL's `LV_STYLE_PROP_FLAG_*`; **Props** is the property group (the `Props::…` constant transitions use, see below); the lookup group is `id >> 4`. The `…Value` types (`ColorValue`, `LengthValue`, `RadiusValue`, `OpacityValue`, `FontValue`) take a fixed value or a design element of `twine_style::design` (e.g. `design::SURFACE`) that the display's theme supplies.

## Property groups

Every property belongs to one group of the property table; each group is a `Props` constant (`Props::BG | Props::TRANSFORM`), e.g. for `Transition::of`.

| Group | Members |
|-------|---------|
| `Props::SIZE` | `width`, `min_width`, `max_width`, `height`, `min_height`, `max_height` |
| `Props::POSITION` | `x`, `y`, `align` |
| `Props::TRANSFORM` | `transform_width`, `transform_height`, `translate_x`, `translate_y`, `translate_radial`, `transform_scale_x`, `transform_scale_y`, `transform_rotation`, `transform_pivot_x`, `transform_pivot_y`, `transform_skew_x`, `transform_skew_y` |
| `Props::PADDING` | `padding_top`, `padding_bottom`, `padding_left`, `padding_right`, `row_gap`, `column_gap`, `padding_radial` |
| `Props::MARGIN` | `margin_top`, `margin_bottom`, `margin_left`, `margin_right` |
| `Props::BG` | `bg_color`, `bg_opacity`, `bg_gradient_color`, `bg_gradient_dir`, `bg_gradient_start`, `bg_gradient_end`, `bg_gradient_start_opacity`, `bg_gradient_end_opacity`, `bg_gradient`, `bg_image`, `bg_image_opacity`, `bg_image_recolor`, `bg_image_recolor_opacity`, `bg_image_tiled` |
| `Props::BORDER` | `border_color`, `border_opacity`, `border_width`, `border_side`, `border_above_children` |
| `Props::OUTLINE` | `outline_width`, `outline_color`, `outline_opacity`, `outline_offset` |
| `Props::SHADOW` | `shadow_width`, `shadow_offset_x`, `shadow_offset_y`, `shadow_spread`, `shadow_color`, `shadow_opacity` |
| `Props::DROP_SHADOW` | `drop_shadow_radius`, `drop_shadow_offset_x`, `drop_shadow_offset_y`, `drop_shadow_color`, `drop_shadow_opacity`, `drop_shadow_quality` |

## Shorthands

Shorthands set several properties at once and have the same name in `style!` (several parameters are written as a tuple: `border: (1, Color::BLACK)`), `StyleBuf` and `ViewExt`.

| Shorthand | Parameters | Sets | Former names |
|-----------|------------|------|--------------|
| `size` | `width: LengthValue, height: LengthValue` | `width`, `height` | — |
| `pos` | `x: LengthValue, y: LengthValue` | `x`, `y` | — |
| `translate` | `x: LengthValue, y: LengthValue` | `translate_x`, `translate_y` | — |
| `offset` | `point: Point` | `translate_x`, `translate_y` | — |
| `padding` | `v: LengthValue` | `padding_top`, `padding_bottom`, `padding_left`, `padding_right` | `pad_all` |
| `padding_x` | `v: LengthValue` | `padding_left`, `padding_right` | `pad_hor`, `padding_hor` |
| `padding_y` | `v: LengthValue` | `padding_top`, `padding_bottom` | `pad_ver`, `padding_ver` |
| `padding_each` | `insets: Insets` | `padding_top`, `padding_bottom`, `padding_left`, `padding_right` | — |
| `margin` | `v: LengthValue` | `margin_top`, `margin_bottom`, `margin_left`, `margin_right` | `margin_all` |
| `margin_x` | `v: LengthValue` | `margin_left`, `margin_right` | `margin_hor` |
| `margin_y` | `v: LengthValue` | `margin_top`, `margin_bottom` | `margin_ver` |
| `margin_each` | `insets: Insets` | `margin_top`, `margin_bottom`, `margin_left`, `margin_right` | — |
| `gap` | `v: LengthValue` | `row_gap`, `column_gap` | `pad_gap` |
| `bg` | `color: ColorValue` | `bg_color`, `bg_opacity` | — |
| `border` | `width: LengthValue, color: ColorValue` | `border_width`, `border_color`, `border_opacity` | — |
| `outline` | `width: i32, color: ColorValue, offset: i32` | `outline_width`, `outline_color`, `outline_opacity`, `outline_offset` | — |
| `shadow` | `shadow: ShadowDsc` | `shadow_width`, `shadow_offset_x`, `shadow_offset_y`, `shadow_spread`, `shadow_color`, `shadow_opacity` | — |
| `shadow_offset` | `x: i32, y: i32` | `shadow_offset_x`, `shadow_offset_y` | — |
| `transform_scale` | `scale: Scale` | `transform_scale_x`, `transform_scale_y` | — |
| `transform_pivot` | `point: Point` | `transform_pivot_x`, `transform_pivot_y` | — |
| `grid_col` | `columns: GridSpan` | `grid_cell_column`, `grid_cell_column_span` | `grid_cell` |
| `grid_row` | `rows: GridSpan` | `grid_cell_row`, `grid_cell_row_span` | `grid_cell` |
| `grid_align` | `x: GridAlign, y: GridAlign` | `grid_cell_x_align`, `grid_cell_y_align` | `grid_cell_align` |
